label: From a schedule to lifetimes
subgoals: Find the step in which each value is written
Find the step of its last read
Take the interval from the step after the write to the last read

label: Counting live values
subgoals: Count the lifetimes that contain each step
Take the maximum count over all steps
Report it as the minimum register count

label: Values with several readers
subgoals: Find every read step of each value
Extend the lifetime to the latest read
Recount the live values per step with the extended lifetimes
